data.title: 户隐憧子 · 晚归雨夜的解衣擦拭
data.description: 暴雨夜归后，玄关的暖灯洒下温馨橙光。憧子学姐褪去湿漉漉的外套，仅穿着柔软的真丝内搭。她拿着干毛巾耐心地为对方擦拭发梢的雨珠，两人呼吸相闻间，她的动作渐渐慢了下来，目光在对方唇瓣上悄然停驻。
data.action: drying hair with towel, close proximity, gaze lingering on lips
data.promptProse: In the warm amber light of the apartment entryway during a rainstorm, Togakushi Touko gently dries the viewer's damp hair with a soft towel. Wearing a delicate silk robe, her breath falters as her gaze lingers lovingly on the viewer's lips in close proximity.
data.animaCaption: Touko gently drying damp hair in the doorway with a tender lingering look.
